Market today: The mood for tech/chips is cautiously optimistic, with chip stocks showing signs of life after a tough period. The real driver is a potential rebound from recent selloffs in the semiconductor sector.

Your holdings: Your leveraged chip ETFs, SOXL (-55.48%) and MUU (-30.69%), are still deep in the red and need close attention due to decay and margin amplification. SMCI (-26.61%) also shows significant loss.

Watch: Keep a close eye on whether the reported chip rebound holds, especially for your leveraged positions. Also, monitor SMH as it's near its stop.

Bottom line: Focus on managing risk in your deeply negative leveraged positions and respecting your stops amidst potential sector recovery.
plays: SMH: Scanner says TRIM and it's very close to its 540 stop. Watch this level carefully.
SOXL, MUU: These leveraged chip ETFs are down significantly. Re-evaluate their stops (SOXL 200, MUU 31.6) in light of the chip sector rebound news.
No new buys today - hold and watch.
